commentary: While headline indices staged an aggressive rebound on October 15, market breadth remained noticeably narrow with a breadth score of 40 and mid/small caps closing negative. As Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil cautioned, benchmark rallies led solely by index heavyweights without broad institutional participation are vulnerable to sudden pullbacks. Under a 'WEAK' market gate, Jesse Livermore's discipline requires patience and Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules demand strict risk control. Traders should avoid chasing extended beta and concentrate strictly on pristine Stage 2 structures exhibiting confirmed CANSLIM earnings acceleration and tight volume contractions, cutting losses without hesitation if designated pivots fail.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating tightly near its 20-session pivot at 958.91 with volume expanding to 1.75× average. The price structure trades soundly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with an RSI of 61 reflecting constructive momentum without overextension.
63MOONS.fundamental: Top line expanded 350% YoY to ₹137 Cr in Q1 FY27, but net profitability remains deeply erratic, swinging to a quarterly loss. Persistent operational losses and negative ROE disqualify the company from CANSLIM leadership.
63MOONS.risk: Failure to clear pivot 958.91 with volume; a violation of 874.22 stop breaches the moving average buffer, demanding immediate exit.

ABDL.technical: Trading within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 754.55. Price maintains clean alignment above SMA50 and SMA200, supported by positive MACD trajectory and an RSI of 69 indicating steady institutional demand.
ABDL.fundamental: Q1 FY27 standalone net sales grew 5.3% YoY to ₹975 Cr with PAT up 11.9% to ₹68 Cr. While balance sheet deleveraging continues post-listing, modest single-digit top-line growth fails CANSLIM's high-momentum benchmarks.
ABDL.risk: A drop below 687.01 breaks the consolidation base; lack of strong earnings catalyst increases risk of failure in divergent markets.

ADVANCE.technical: Classic Darvas-style breakout clearing a 20-session high to reach fresh trailing-year highs at 151.97. High volume expansion at 7.66× average confirms intense institutional buying, riding well above rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Exceptional operational momentum with Q1 FY27 net profit surging 152% YoY to ₹22.55 Cr on a 96% jump in revenue to ₹330 Cr. Backed by robust 19.6% ROCE and negligible leverage in agrochemicals.
ADVANCE.risk: Break back into the base below 134.56 invalidates the breakout; small-cap volatility requires strict stop compliance.

AEGISLOG.technical: Resolving out of a double-bottom structure with price reclaiming 1530.23 on exceptional 4.64× average volume. Moving average alignment is strongly bullish above SMA50 and SMA200, while RSI at 57 leaves substantial upside headroom.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Pristine CANSLIM profile with Q1 FY27 PAT leaping 212% to ₹545 Cr and revenue beating estimates by 47%. Driven by a 91% surge in LPG distribution volumes and expanding terminal margins via Aegis Vopak JV.
AEGISLOG.risk: Close below 1379.53 breaches the base low; exit quickly if institutional support wanes or energy commodity volumes contract.

AEROENTER.technical: Constructing a double bottom with pivot trigger at 159.76 on 1.48× volume. Price holds stably above key moving averages with RSI 59 and MACD positioned constructively above the zero line.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Consolidated Q1 FY27 net profit surged 616% YoY to ₹103 Cr on 135% revenue growth to ₹333 Cr. The company is virtually debt-free, though historical reliance on other income and lower ROE requires ongoing scrutiny.
AEROENTER.risk: Violation of 145.36 cracks base support; use partial sizing until multiple quarters verify core operating earnings durability.

ANUHPHR.technical: Double bottom formation putting pressure on its 99.60 neckline, supported by a 3.28× volume surge. Trading well above rising 50, 150, and 200 DMAs in conformity with Weinstein Stage 2 criteria.
ANUHPHR.fundamental: Q1 FY27 net profit jumped 38% YoY to ₹11.42 Cr driven by margin expansion, though revenue growth remained muted at 3.9%. Balance sheet carries negligible debt with a 15% ROCE, offering defensive quality.
ANUHPHR.risk: A breakdown under 91.54 invalidates the neckline base; exit without hesitation if market weakness triggers pattern failure.
